blocks.title: Model changes
blocks.summary: 3 related files share the "model" change signal.

explanations.title: Retry policy rejections once
explanations.summary: A policy rejection now gets one delayed retry. The retry goes through the normal call path, so it is metered separately and still subject to the usual call limits.

explanations.title: Only retry safety-filter rejections
explanations.summary: The retry is limited to HTTP 400 errors whose details mention both a flag and the usage policy; other bad requests, such as an unknown model, still fail immediately.
